SELECT

CASE WHEN APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'A' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' THEN 'DECLINED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS STATUS,

-- 2 **Joinkey not yet finalized**
--PROD_TYPE.PROD_VARIANT AS PROD_VARIANT,
-- 3
APPM_DELTA_DATE AS DATE_STATUS,

-- 4
CASE WHEN MAX(APPM_DATE_MAINT) >= MAX(APPM_DELTA_DATE) THEN MAX(APPM_DATE_MAINT) ELSE MAX(APPM_DELTA_DATE) END AS APP_DATE,

-- 5 to 16
APPM_DATE_INPUT,
ld.APPM_NBR,
APPM_PDT_NBR,
APPM_CURRENT_STEP,
APPM_ACC_DCL_IND,
APPM_GEMP_ZIP,
APPM_FORMAT_ID,
APPM_DATE_MAINT,
APPM_PRIN_FNAME,
APPM_PRIN_MNAME,
APPM_PRIN_LNAME,
APPM_DELTA_DATE,

-- 17 to 20
SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE, 1, 3) AS PGM_CODE,
SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE, 4, 3) AS MAIN_SALES_CHNL,
SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE, 17, 4) AS SUB_PGM_CODE,
SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE, 7, 4) AS BRANCH_CODE,

-- 21
CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('DD',APPM_GEMP_ZIP) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DD_TAG,

-- 22
APPM_AGENT_CODE AS AGENT_CODE,

--23 **Joinkey not yet finalized**
--CASE WHEN DEC_REASON.APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' THEN DEC_REASON.Code ELSE '' END AS DECLINE_REASON,

--24 ** Still finalizing**
-- COMPRESS(APPM_GEMP_ZIP) AS DECLINE_CODE

--25 to 28
APPM_REF_NAME AS REF_NAME,
APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT AS ACCT_CRLIMIT,
APPM_LOCAL_NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
APPM_CARD_IND AS CARD_IND,

-- 29 to 30
YEAR(APPM_DELTA_DATE) AS YR_STATUS,
MONTH(APPM_DELTA_DATE) AS MON_STATUS,

-- 31 CNT
NULL AS CNT,

-- 32 to 36 **Joinkey not yet finalized**
--LOC.AREA_CODE AS Area,
--LOC.REGION_CODE AS Region,
--LOC.REGION AS Region_1,
--LOC.BRANCH_NAME AS BRANCH_NAME_,
--CASE
--    WHEN SUBSTRING(CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_SOURCE, 4, 3) IN ('DEV', 'CBG') THEN 'OTHERS'
--    WHEN SUBSTRING(CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_SOURCE, 4, 3) = 'CBS' AND SUBSTRING(CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_SOURCE, 17, 4) = 'TST1' THEN 'BERNA'
--    WHEN CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_DELTA_DATE < '2022-05-01' AND SUBSTRING(CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_SOURCE, 17, 4) IN ('0PRV', 'TST1') THEN 'BERNA'
--    WHEN SUBSTRING(CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_SOURCE, 4, 3) NOT IN ('RBB', 'CBS') THEN 'SAM'
--    WHEN SUBSTRING(CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_SOURCE, 4, 3) IN ('TEL') THEN 'BERNA'
--    WHEN SUBSTRING(CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_SOURCE, 4, 3) IN ('DEV', 'CBG') THEN 'OTHERS'
--    WHEN SUBSTRING(CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_SOURCE, 4, 3) IN ('SMP') THEN 'MYRA'
--    WHEN LOC.SALES_OFFICER = '' THEN 'SAM'
--    ELSE LOC.SALES_OFFICER
--END AS SALES_OFFICER

-- 37 to 40
MONTH(APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_MONTH,
YEAR(APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_YEAR,
APPM_GEMP_ADDR2,
APPM_PORA_BPLACE AS DATE_TRANSMITTED,

--41 ** Joinkey not yet finalized**
--CASE WHEN APPM_ACC_DCL_IND IN ('A') THEN CODE_TABLE.DESCRIPTION ELSE '' END AS Dev_Reason,

--42
CASE WHEN APPM_INPUT_OPERATOR = 'BATCH UPLD' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, APPM_DATE_INPUT) ELSE APPM_DATE_INPUT END AS APPM_DATE_INPUT2,

-- 43
APPM_PORA_CUR_ADDR AS DATE_RECEIVED,

--43
CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('DD', APPM_GEMP_ZIP) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS Deviation,

--45
CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(APPM_GEMP_ADDR2, 1, 2) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Reprocessed_tag,

--46 to 48
DATEPART(WEEK, APPM_DELTA_DATE) AS WEEK_STATUS,
MONTH(APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_ASC_MONTH,
YEAR(APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_ASC_YEAR,

-- 49
CASE
WHEN APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND APPM_PAST_DUE = '' THEN 'Applicant has no TU record at all or OBC CL<25K'
WHEN (APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND APPM_EXT_ISSUER1 = '0013' AND APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD1 = '2')
OR (APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND APPM_EXT_ISSUER2 = '0013' AND APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD2 = '2')
OR (APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND APPM_EXT_ISSUER3 = '0013' AND APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD3 = '2')
THEN 'The PNB card submitted is either non-existing, with findings, or does not meet the minimum OBC criteria'
ELSE 'OBC Provided is Secured/Supplementary/Corporate/Prepaid/Debit or is Cancelled'
END AS SUB_DECL_REASON

FROM (SELECT ad.APPM_NBR, MAX(ad.APPM_CURRENT_STEP) AS MAX_STEP, MAX(ad.APPM_DELTA_DATE) AS MAX_DELTA_DATE FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXAPPMP ad
GROUP BY ad.APPM_NBR) ld
INNER JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXAPPMP ccd on ccd.APPM_NBR = ld.APPM_NBR
--INNER JOIN (SELECT PRODUCTID, PROD_VARIANT FROM #REF# ) PROD_TYPE ON CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_PDT_NBR = PROD_TYPE.PRODUCTID 

--INNER JOIN (SELECT Code, APPM_ACC_DCL_IND FROM #REF# ) DEC_REASON ON CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_GEMP_ZIP = DEC_REASON.Code 

--INNER JOIN (SELECT BRANCH_CODE, AREA_CODE, REGION_CODE, REGION, BRANCH_NAME, SALES_OFFICER FROM #REF#) LOC ON SUBSTRING(CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_SOURCE,7,4) = LOC.BRANCH_CODE

-- INNER JOIN (SELECT Code, Description FROM #REF#) CODE_TABLE ON CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_GEMP_ZIP = CODE_TABLE.Code
GROUP BY APPM_ACC_DCL_IND, APPM_DELTA_DATE, APPM_DATE_INPUT, ld.APPM_NBR, APPM_PDT_NBR, APPM_CURRENT_STEP, APPM_ACC_DCL_IND, APPM_GEMP_ZIP, APPM_FORMAT_ID, APPM_DATE_MAINT, APPM_PRIN_FNAME, APPM_PRIN_MNAME, APPM_PRIN_LNAME, APPM_DELTA_DATE, APPM_SOURCE, APPM_GEMP_ZIP, APPM_AGENT_CODE, APPM_REF_NAME, APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT, APPM_LOCAL_NAME, APPM_CARD_IND, APPM_GEMP_ADDR2, APPM_PORA_BPLACE, APPM_INPUT_OPERATOR, APPM_PORA_CUR_ADDR, APPM_PAST_DUE, APPM_EXT_ISSUER1, APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD1, APPM_EXT_ISSUER2, APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD2, APPM_EXT_ISSUER3, APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD3
